description: Exact, expiring security findings observed in the Phase A scanner baseline. Every entry is independently accountable and carries an expiry set by its own review horizon. Refreshed 2026-10-16 (SA295): all nine entries re-adjudicated against the live source and kept; raw-JavaScript seam emissions review quarterly, the encoded JSON seam reviews semi-annually, and the scanner heuristic false positive reviews annually.
